# Kavach Security

> Autonomous code, cloud, and AI agent security platform combining static/cloud scanners, deterministic OPA policy enforcement, verified patch remediation, and immutable PostgreSQL audit evidence.

## Platform Overview

Kavach separates AI investigation from security authority:
- **Deterministic Decision Engine**: Open Policy Agent (OPA Rego), Semgrep, Gitleaks, Trivy, OSV-Scanner, and Checkov authorize actions and verify patches.
- **Scoped MCP Gateway**: AI coding tools connect over the Model Context Protocol with per-agent identity, ABAC permissions, and auditable policy checks.
